fnol_text: My name is Jordan Raman and I live at 899 Foxglove Drive, Madison, WI 53783. You can reach me on (555) 545-6403 or jordan.raman@example.com. After the torrential rain on the night of 16 August 2024, rainwater ran off the field behind us, across the back garden and in under the patio doors. About 5 cm of water covered the kitchen and family room floors. Policy HH-2024-00013. I'd like to claim for the damage to my home. Can you confirm I'm covered for this?

adjuster_notes.text: Called Mrs Raman on (555) 545-6403 to acknowledge the claim. Jordan confirmed the loss date as 16 August 2024.
Site visit to 899 Foxglove Drive. Neighbour Noor Novak was present and confirmed the timeline.
Jordan sent photos and a contractor's estimate. Water line visible on walls.
